I have initiated the test verification run for the specified tests and am waiting for the execution to complete.
I have investigated the issue, identified the root cause, implemented the fix, and verified that all failing tests now pass.

### Root Cause
In [`BasicMonthOfYearDateTimeField.add(ReadablePartial, int, int[], int)`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/time_14_group_b_fix/src/main/java/org/joda/time/chrono/BasicMonthOfYearDateTimeField.java#L203-L220), calculations for contiguous partials converted field values into a millisecond instant starting at `0L` (1970-01-01 UTC). Because 1970 is not a leap year, any partial lacking a year field (such as [`MonthDay`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/time_14_group_b_fix/src/main/java/org/joda/time/MonthDay.java)) with February 29 would fail validation with an `IllegalFieldValueException: Value 29 for dayOfMonth must be in the range [1,28]`. Furthermore, transitions into February (e.g. subtracting a month from March 31) adjusted to February 28 instead of February 29.

### Solution
Added handling in [`BasicMonthOfYearDateTimeField.add`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/time_14_group_b_fix/src/main/java/org/joda/time/chrono/BasicMonthOfYearDateTimeField.java#L209-L214) when `monthOfYear` is the largest field in the partial (`fieldIndex == 0`). The new month is computed by wrapping within the 12-month cycle and applied using `set(partial, 0, values, newMonth)`, correctly adjusting subordinate fields (such as day-of-month) according to the partial's chronology constraints without defaulting to the non-leap year 1970.

### Verification
Ran all 8 original failing tests in `org.joda.time.TestMonthDay_Basics`:
- `testPlusMonths_int_negativeFromLeap`
- `testMinusDays_int_negativeFromLeap`
- `testPlusMonths_int_fromLeap`
- `testPlusMonths_int_negativeEndOfMonthAdjust`
- `testMinusMonths_int_endOfMonthAdjust`
- `testMinusMonths_int_negativeFromLeap`
- `testMinusMonths_int_fromLeap`
- `testPlusDays_int_fromLeap`

All tests passed with 0 failures.

The focused patch containing only the source code changes has been saved to [nl_fix.patch](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/time_14_group_b_fix/nl_fix.patch).
